description: This file defines an interface and implementation for interacting with nftables via command-line, including functions for listing objects, rules, and elements, parsing JSON output, and executing nft commands.

classes.name: nftContext
classes.description: Holds context information for nftables operations, including family, table, and comment support flag.

classes.name: realNFTables
classes.description: Implements the Interface for nftables interactions, managing command execution, JSON parsing, and command batching.

classes.name: Rule
classes.description: Represents an nftables rule with chain, handle, and comment fields.

classes.name: Element
classes.description: Represents an nftables element with key, value, set, map, and optional comment.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Represents a batch of nftables commands to be executed atomically.

methods.name: newInternal
methods.description: Creates a new nftables interface with a specified executor, used for testing.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new nftables interface with the real executor.

methods.name: NewTransaction
methods.description: Creates a new transaction for batching commands.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes a transaction by running the batched commands.

methods.name: Check
methods.description: Performs a dry-run check of a transaction.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists objects of a specified type within the current table and family.

methods.name: ListRules
methods.description: Lists rules within a specified chain or entire table.

methods.name: ListElements
methods.description: Lists elements within a set or map.

methods.name: jsonVal
methods.description: Helper to extract typed value from JSON map.

methods.name: getJSONObjects
methods.description: Parses nftables JSON output and extracts objects of a given type.

methods.name: parseElementValue
methods.description: Parses JSON element values, handling concatenations, prefixes, and verdicts.
